title: Identify a moving object in the sky
description: Pointing is tied to the current place, the time and the data available about the object.

blocks.text: You want to name a bright moving dot right while you are watching it. An error in the direction quickly makes the hint meaningless.

quote.text: I wanted an app that I could point my phone into the sky to display the satellites that are currently overhead.

blocks.text: Show how the direction and the suggested object line up, and let the place and time be checked. Where the match is doubtful, leave room to refine it.
Do not promise confident recognition of any object. Accuracy depends on the data, the device and the observing conditions.
